title: lichen-core: cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings fails on pre-existing lints
description: Discovered while verifying loadng.rs fixes (project-LICHEN-worker6-595h et al). cargo clippy -p lichen-core --all-targets -- -D warnings fails on code untouched by that work: (1) tdma_beacon.rs:185 manual_range_contains (present at committed HEAD, verified byte-identical to HEAD); (2) lib.rs ~10x manual_range/manual_range_inclusive_contains; (3) duty_cycle.rs:937 clone_on_copy (test target). Also cargo fmt -p lichen-core --check shows drift in tdma_beacon.rs, transport.rs, tx_queue.rs, tests/*. None of these are in loadng.rs. Proof: clippy passes with only -A clippy::manual-range-contains -A clippy::clone-on-copy.
